D_cb    = 54.0   # mm  top counterbore diameter (Ø54)

W_tot   = 69.5   # mm  overall width including tab

tab_h   = 20.0   # mm  tab height (Z)
tab_zc  = 40.0   # mm  tab centre height

hole_dp = 12.0   # mm  blind-hole depth (↓12 from bottom)
hole_bc = 54.0   # mm  bolt-circle diameter (Ø54 BC)
n_holes = 10     #     holes, equally spaced

R_in  = D_in  / 2                      # 24
R_cb  = D_cb  / 2                      # 27
R_bc  = hole_bc / 2                    # 27

tab_xi    = R_in + 1.0                 # tab root embedded in wall (x = 25)

part -= Cylinder(R_in, H_tot + 2,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, -1))

# ── Top counterbore Ø54 × 8 deep (z = 80 → 88) ───────────────────

                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)).translate((0, 0, H_body))

          align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
